name: Vexcord Plugins
description: First-party Vexcord extensions · audio, playback and more.

vexcord.bitchord-presence.name: BitChord Presence
vexcord.bitchord-presence.description: Shows BitChord playback as a listening activity with title, artist, album, optional public cover, time progress and track link.
vexcord.bitchord-presence.author: Veyra (https://github.com/ctrl-mietze/Vexcord "Vexcord")

vexcord.stereo-call.name: Stereo Call
vexcord.stereo-call.description: Route-aware Bluetooth stereo priority for Discord voice. Retains normal routing on wired, USB and LE Audio devices; restores the original request when necessary.
vexcord.stereo-call.author: Veyra (https://github.com/ctrl-mietze/Vexcord "Vexcord")
